title: I already paid for premium features but now need to pay more?
body:
I used to be a satisfied customer and I did purchase the premium features on the first day of using it when it was a one-time thing. Now after the last update, NOTHING new was added that I care about, and you TOOK AWAY the features that I already paid for! Now you’re telling me I need to SUBSCRIBE? That’s terrible business practices. Next time what, you double the price without adding anything?
Not to mention that there’s no real cloud functionality apart from backup (which is handled by Apple), there’s nothing to justify recurring payment for a feature that has been finished and working for month.
